r.t: Yu Ijin is the central protagonist of the

series. A gifted young mercenary and survivor of a plane crash, he opens the story when he returns to Korea after a decade to reunite with his family. His sole intent is to keep a low profile, but this is increasingly thwarted by school bullies, kidnappers and international criminals. This doc will be going over the many feats of intelligence he displayed throughout the story. I will try to go over all of Ijin’s feats in the story in as much detail as possible.
Cyan: Full Scale IQ, Crystallized and Fluid Intelligence, Intelligence Categories

Has 10 years of experience. From the age of 9, after being rescued out of a plane crash, he was trained by The Camp, a special experimental unit under Iron, a global private military corporation. By the age of 15,

he received the title of 001 of the numbers, a group of 40 out of the 1,000 individuals who survived the hellish training of The Camp, as well as death-defying missions and dangerous battlefields. Mad Dog even refers to Ijin as “the perfect soldier” in episode 134. His training from 004 allowed him to power through pain in order to continue fighting, even if cornered and on the brink of death.

From what’s been shown so far throughout the story, Ijin has been trained in martial arts, knife combat, marksmanship, assassination, leadership skills, teamwork, espionage, hacking, and military tactics. He also learned English and Korean, as well as another language during his time as a mercenary

During Episodes 160 and 161, When Immortal and his band of pillagers attacked the mercenary camp Ijin lived in for 5 years, he pretended to be a civilian in order to surprise attack them, before taking out the soldiers surrounding the civilians and killing Immortal

In Episode 0, Ijin went to rescue the RoK lieutenant named Kang Hamchan. When they faced two soldiers, Ijin immediately disarmed and incapacitated them without taking out his gun in order to not give away their location
He also took into account the of the other two men and their weak states, having everything calculated
Noticed that a bully was leaving himself too wide open for someone trying to start a fight, closing in on him without a second and leaving his pressure points open for attack
Gave a glare to one of Dayun’s bullies that terrifies her, before immediately quickly switching to a more calm and comforting personality when he notices Dayun watching
with the bully even questioning how Ijin is the same guy who glared at her a minute ago
Notices the small blood stains on Dayeon’s shoe and quickly comes to the realization that she was attacked by Huijin and her friends
He also keeps calm and goes along with her story about falling down some stairs while dodging a bike while giving her first aid, understanding her feelings of helplessness
Later on, he goes to the bar that Gisu and his gang hang out at, and defeats them by first boxing them in, attacking the ones on the outside first and causing the rest to try and go over the table
taking him only a few seconds to use the structure of the room
He also threatens Gisu to keep his sister in check, choking him with his elbow to the point where he was hospitalized with a neck brace
When Cha Dusik’s men came to Ijin’s home asking for him, Ijin tells his grandpa and Dayeon that they’re acquaintances in order to de-escalate the situation
When Dusik meets him, he notices how Ijin doesn’t have any emotion on his face, despite supposedly being in danger
After defeating Dusik and his men, he pays a visit to Inbae Kim’s office to reveal one of the videos of Huijin bullying Dayeon

Before the visit, it is shown that he had entered the Kim family residence and downloaded the videos of Gisu and Huijin’s bullying off of their laptop. He also recorded the call between Inbae’s wife and Cha Dusik, hiring him and his men to assault Ijin
He convinces Inbae to send Gisu and Huijin abroad by tomorrow
Followed Huijin to the meeting place between her and her friends, predicting that she would try to harm Dayun again
In order to hide his identity and completely stop Dayun’s bullying problems,
he exposed Huijin and Gisu Kim’s bullying videos, as well as evidence of Inbae Kim’s involvement in money laundering, bribery, and election fraud,
which he had accessed by hacking into Cha Dusik’s computer
Maintained his composure despite learning that Sukjoo and Yeona were investigating him.
Even after Sukjoo claims the records to the school he supposedly attended overseas were forged,
and that they never heard of Ijin, he doesn’t flinch
and even asks for proof, making it seem as if Sukjoo is falsely accusing him

Ijin was heading to the store to walk home with Dayun in their grandfather’s stead, before being confronted by Sukjoo, with him and Yuna believing that Ijin is a threat wanting to claim the insurance money from his parent’s death. Suddenly, both Ijin and Sukjoo were hit by a van, driven by retired soldiers who kidnapped both Yuna and Dayun, wanting a ransom for the former.
Despite his injuries, he quickly asks Sukjoo where is his best guess on where they were taken, before deciding to search for Dayun himself.

He pays a visit to Dusik Cha and informs him of the situation. Dusik claims that the soldiers were asking around for an untraceable warehouse, as well as burner cars and extra hands, but Dusik turned them down. Another crew took the bait and are working outside of Incheon.

When going outside to borrow Dusik’s bike, Sukjoo asks if he’s really going to follow such a weak lead. Ijin replies by saying that they’ll keep Yuna safe until they get what they want, and that there’s no telling what they would do to Dayun

Once at the address for the warehouse, the address given to him by Dusik, he and Sukjoo began dispatching the men that were keeping watch of the warehouse. After a while, Ijin asks how many men Sukjoo took down, Sukjoo answers with 5. Ijin took out 9, meaning they took out 14 in total, allowing Ijin to realize they aren’t short of men or resources. He also realizes that the wire puller/actual kidnappers are somewhere with Yeona, and that the thugs he and Sukjoo were taking out weren’t nearly as capable as to devise a plan to kidnap Yeona
Broke through Beomseok’s upper guard by striking his knees and then striking his neck,
which was enough to narrow the gap of physical strength between them.

Created an excuse that the two guards he fought let their guards down, holding back because Ijin was an inexperienced kid and because of that, he had a greater advantage over them. If they had considered him an actual opponent and gave it their best, he would have lost. The SW director believes he made a perfect assessment of the situation;
During the ride back to SW, he noticed a drunk driver about to crash into them
and immediately went to protect Jiyeh from being injured.

Major Kang and his team were ambushed by Mad Dog’s mercenaries in a region called Grain, one of the sectors he used to work in during his mercenary days. From watching their footprints on the ground, he realizes that Major Kang and his group hadn’t planned their escape from the first foothold, and they were forced onto the second foothold. Using his knowledge of the region to his advantage, he plans to ambush the troops attacking Major Kang’s group to keep them busy as Major Kang and his men escape. He attacks from various angles as the enemy won’t be able to figure out his position. Even when they realize his plan, he takes notice of the fact that he had taken out a large majority of them. He also counters their attempt to attack him from a different direction,
which he knew they would do beforehand

. He was able to keep the soldiers at bay until the rescue team arrived, which took 3 hours and 20 minutes. The Alpha team was wiped out, unable to put up a fight. The Delta team were ambushed while moving, resulting in 17 out of 20 of them being killed. The Delta and Alpha team also couldn’t figure anything out other than the enemy was small in number.
Noticed that Sukjoo was watching him
and trying to beat him during every training session, understanding that he can’t help but to compare himself to Ijin due to them being the same age
and even let his family speak to 006/Liam, a number who was hunting down and trying to kill Ijin at the time
He and Liam went from fighting each other to cleaning up the mess they left on the table as soon as someone walked out of the convenience store and before they turned their sights on them
Asks for Sukjoo to track Liam‘s location due to the risk that he may go after Kangsu (Ijin’s grandfather) and Dayeon first
Realizes that Liam must have arrived at the location Seokjoo sent him recently, otherwise he would have gotten a place closer to Ijin if he had the time
Is holding back around the SW bodyguards
in order to try and blend in.
Jiyeh notices he is also quietly enduring the harsh training
and that the men are slowly warming up to him.
Knows that the one who kidnapped Jiyeh will make their escape by car, so he quickly heads to the parking lot. Jumps over some cars in order to reach the kidnappers’ minivan.
Took advantage of the female kidnapper/Krisilla being distracted by Jiyeh
and quickly disarmed her of her gun.
Krisilla noticed how Ijin didn’t even think before pulling the trigger and that his eyes are dead still after shooting someone
Cha Seoha is an actress who was being stalked for over 2 weeks. They somehow knew her address and began to leave strange letters in her mailbox.
As he was investigating the JHS studio, he found a spy camera in the waiting room.

figured out that the head of marketing from the KP group, Donggeun Ki, fabricated the stalker in time for Seoha’s contract renewal, allowing him to assign a bodyguard to her for constant surveillance, as well as that bad management almost ran Sterling Entertainment to the ground before KP group’s investment, and Seoha’s leaving would be a great loss to both companies since she’s the agency’s greatest asset. He also knows of the countless threats towards Seoha due to her reluctance to renew the contract,
information that he gathered using his phone.
Deduced that 004 is the one who killed the mercenaries who captured 032 due to remembering
004’s habit of leaving enemies alive to take out in close combat, rather than shooting from a safe distance.

Disguised himself to enter MH High School to watch over Jinwu Cha, Seoha’s brother. After learning he was being bullied and why he won’t tell Seoha, he went to beat up his bullies, especially Yeongsik, who he threatens and beats up repeatedly, even breaking his finger, to make him stop bullying.
He also discovered one of the female bullies’ videos and how she manipulated the boys in her class to bully Jinwu Cha.
Knew Yeona was getting upset with her conversation with Lewin Bailey,
and decided to inform them that it’s time to head to their next location in order to end the conversation.
After learning of Lewin’s plan to humiliate him, Ijin decides to do the same by beating his bodyguards one by one and taunting him after defeating a bodyguard.
Noticed a man with a spider tattoo, who was an assassin heading to attack and kill Lewin, and went in pursuit after him.
Inducted that Gilsu Kang never fired a gun in actual combat
due to trying to shoot Ijin as he was moving.
Was able to figure out that Mad Dog didn’t send 005 and that her target is someone in SW,
due to finding him while tracking down her target and being surprised that he’s still alive.

He, 005, 006, and 032 discovered that Yeongho Shin was the one who hired 005 to assassinate Jiyeh due to 006 being hired under an alias to kill her, as well as downloading files from Yeongho’s assistant’s computer.
They exposed Yeongho to the SW director, as well as bring Yeongho to him,
already expecting him to not be complacent due to knowing that the evidence wouldn’t hold up in court. They also incapacitated Yeongho’s guards as well.
Noticed the bloodstains on an Forest soldier, Anna, pretending to be a bodyguard for Andrew Vorrei’s son and daughter
Figured out they were being ambushed due to the fact that only two members of their security team are supposed to have firearms, one in the car in front of them
Calculated that he should be approximately 200 meters from the VIPs, after engaging in a brief scuffle with Anna and her men
Looked in a different direction in order to make Anna look in the same direction and distract her
Figured out that her goal is to capture them, due to the fact she would have plenty of opportunities to actually kill them but didn’t, something he kept note of for over two days,
all while in the middle of an ambush and full on shooting
Figured out that the bodyguard with the VIPs was a traitor

due to the fact that the enemy shouldn’t have pinpointed their location so soon, as well as noticing that the bodyguard didn’t check their hiding spot, and that he had a gun despite not being on the list of personnel allowed to have one

After learning Dayun and his grandpa had been kidnapped by Mad Dog, he was forced to listen to Mad Dog’s commands in order to save them, while also being unable to call anyone for help. While already tired from traveling in circles due to being sent towards false locations by Mad Dog, he also had to get past multiple teams of FOREST soldiers, who were trained to try and surpass the numbers in every possible way
He manages to take out all of them, with Mad Dog claiming that he’s not even using any special tactics

Once Anna was faced with Ijin, she attempted to use flash grenades to disorient him. However before she could attack, Ijin blocked her field of vision with his jacket, allowing him to fire back and eventually get close enough to incapacitate her
Was able to tell that someone (that being Alice) was watching him from a distance, with Alice claiming that he has the senses of a hawk
Realized that Alice did not know he was 001 due to her reaction of seeing 002 and telling Ijin to go ahead
